title: Session event
description: One line of 03_MEMORY/events/session_events.jsonl. The log is append-only, UTF-8, LF-terminated, one complete JSON object per line, never pretty-printed, and every line is independently parseable and schema-valid. The `oneOf` below is keyed on `type`: exactly one branch applies to any valid event, and the validator reports which branch was closest when none matches.

subject_id.description: null for workspace-level events such as memory_backup.

approach.description: The intervention name, so it can land in helpful_interventions or failed_interventions.

independent.description: True only when outcome is independent_success and hints_used is 0.

level.description: 1 orienting question, 2 principle named, 3 first step shown, 4 full solution.

relative_path.description: Workspace-relative with forward slashes. No leading slash, no backslash, and no colon — so a drive letter or an absolute path cannot be stored.
